content.short: Kryptonite is the premier liquid staking and lending protocol on Sei, featuring the stSEI liquid staking derivative.
content.description: Kryptonite is the leading decentralized liquid staking and money market protocol built natively on the Sei Network. The platform enables users to stake their SEI tokens to receive stSEI, a liquid staking derivative that earns rewards while remaining highly composable within the Sei DeFi ecosystem. Functioning as Sei's primary bond market, Kryptonite allows participants to use their stSEI as collateral to borrow stablecoins or leverage their positions to amplify staking yields. Powered by the SEILOR token, the protocol provides a secure framework for decentralized asset management.
content.meta: Kryptonite provides liquid staking and decentralized lending services on the Sei Network. Discover Kryptonite and more dApps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
